title: Travel 3
note: B2 TEMPLATE unit, James dropdowns 2026-09-05: Oxford B2/C1 anchored, every candidate word checked against the whole-course pool before entry (visa/itinerary/currency/customs etc. were already taught and are excluded). C57 recap card of Travel 2. C49 all 36 words shown in three boards of 12. Build-the-family card per B2-PLAN: reserve/confirm/cancel/take off/land -> reservation/confirmation/cancellation/takeoff/landing, all five drilled as bank items. A12 senses: package (holiday), aisle (plane), trail (walking). E10 Use is rewrite production; every underline reconstructs its answer (check_rewrite clean).

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Travel 2 was the journey going wrong — delay, cancel, connection, refund, complain, insurance — and the hotel: accommodation, receptionist, check out. Those words come back in this unit's sentences. Everything on the next three boards is new: the airport, the road and the water.
cards.note_cz: Travel 2 byla cesta, která se pokazila — delay, cancel, connection, refund, complain, insurance — a hotel: accommodation, receptionist, check out. Ta slova se vracejí ve větách. Všechno na dalších třech tabulích je nové: letiště, silnice a voda.

cards.title: Build the family
points: Verbs you know become this unit's nouns.
**-ation** and **-ing** do the building — five of the 36 words are made this way.

cards.title: You will use these words in

blocks.title: Travel · on the road and water

sentences.en: You should reserve a table before you arrive.
